topography.project_purpose: Yield. Structurally: 80 project-authored contract(s) across 2 chain(s); 3 ERC4626 vaults, 8 ERC20 tokens, 2 Chainlink feeds; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 3 functional families. Its contracts share 22 common project-authored base contract(s) (reentrancyguarddeprecated, reentrancyguardtransient, pauseable). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
